title: Data Breach Dispute
question_for_arbitration: The Claimant asserts a breach of contract based on a data breach that exposed sensitive family PII submitted through the platform. The Claimant seeks $7,500.00 under the New York SHIELD Act (N.Y. Gen. Bus. Law § 899-bb) as the baseline standard for reasonable data care, arguing that WeMoveYou's rolling contract updates render its dispute and liability terms illusory. The Respondent moves to dismiss or severely limit damages based on its standard online "Disclaimer of Warranties" and "Limitation of Liability" clauses.
